metadata.built_by: data.py (uv run data.py) -- local files only, no network access
metadata.scope_guard: DATA ONLY. No model weights were downloaded, no forward pass was run, nothing was trained, no detector statistic (W01-W05) was computed and no AUROC is reported. Parameter counts come from the Hub's safetensors index; file sizes from the Hub file index.
metadata.demo_note: Curated demo subset: 100 of 672 edit_manifest rows (Block 1 only), stratified over every populated recipe class and including the declared parents of the picked edited rows. File lists are trimmed to weight shards. Full data: full_data_out.json.
